args.name: pwa-drawer-swipe
args.description: Close a PWA drawer on a horizontal swipe.
args.body:
## When to use
A PWA drawer that must close on a horizontal swipe.

## Procedure
1. Listen to pointerdown/pointermove on the drawer element, never the body.
2. Close when dx < -80px within 450ms.

## Pitfalls
Safari needs pointer events, not touch events.

## Verification
Swipe on iOS Safari and Android Chrome.
